name: 神圣狮鹫（高山地的样子）
evolution: 小狮鹫 → 神圣狮鹫（高山地的样子） Lv.32 → 皇家狮鹫 Lv.46
evolutionEn: Xiaoshijiu → Shenshengshijiu (Highland form) Lv.32 → Huangjiashijiu Lv.46
description: 高山地的环境更加寒冷，高山的狮鹫家族在这里演化出能抵抗寒冷的身体结构，身上的羽毛除了用于飞行的硬羽之外，还有大量绒毛，这种绒毛疏水抗风极其厚实，小洛克使劲吹都吹不开。
descriptionEn: The highland environment is colder; the mountain griffin family has here evolved body structures that resist the cold. Besides the stiff flight feathers used for flying, their plumage includes a large amount of down, which is highly hydrophobic, wind-resistant and extremely thick—even a young Locke cannot blow it apart no matter how hard they try.

skills.name: 疾风刺
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，若先于敌方攻击，改为3连击。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 1 combo; if attacking before the enemy, changes to 3 combos.

skills.name: 飞羽
skills.descriptionEn: Swift; dispels one buff from the enemy.

skills.name: 见招拆招
skills.description: 造成物伤，若上回合使用状态技能，本次技能威力+55。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if a status skill was used last turn, this skill's power +55.

skills.name: 羽化加速
skills.description: 自己获得全技能威力+20，迅捷。
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains all skills power +20, Swift.

skills.name: 扇风
skills.description: 造成物伤，若先于敌方攻击，本次技能威力+50%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if attacking before the enemy, this skill's power +50%.

skills.name: 闪击
skills.description: 造成物伤，速度比敌方越高，本次技能威力越高。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the higher one's speed than the enemy's, the higher this skill's power.

skills.name: 快速移动
skills.description: 自己获得速度+80，应对防御：改为速度+160。
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains Speed +80; against Defense: changes to Speed +160.

skills.name: 羽刃
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：回合结束使敌方紧急脱离。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; against status: at end of turn forces the enemy to retreat urgently.

skills.name: 龙卷风
skills.description: 造成物伤，迅捷，应对状态：本次技能威力变为1.5倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, Swift; against status: this skill's power becomes 1.5x.
